title: Friday: budget deadline day and T-bane day two
intro: Government parties face their self-imposed budget deadline while the metro shutdown continues through Sunday.

big-news.text: Today was the target date for the government and its allies to agree the 2027 state budget. Norgespris at 40 vs 45 øre/kWh is a sticking point — the deal may slip to Monday or later.
Equinor's cyberattack enters day three. Friday morning the company said it had stopped the attack; NSM says it targeted Microsoft Azure API Management and also hit Skagerak Energi.

whats-changing.text: Norwegian (the airline) asked roughly 5,000 customers to block their payment cards after suspicious transactions — a precaution after fraud attempts linked to the carrier.

oslo.text: T-bane shutdown day two of four. Same pattern as Thursday: no metro through the centre, limited service on western ends of lines 1–3 only.

be-aware.text: Clear, dry and cold weekend ahead in the capital — good for walking, but frosty mornings can make pavements slippery.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Jul i Vinterland at Spikersuppa — rink, lights and market atmosphere in the heart of the city.
